clips.topic_zh: 比特幣 vs 黃金十年
clips.text_zh: /biz/ 今日問：如果只可以揸一樣十年，你揀 BTC 定黃金？香港人答晒 gold，但美國仔答晒 BTC。我揀 BTC，黃金只係玩具。prop firm 啱啱又輸多單，又係學費 😭
clips.text_en_b1: Bitcoin vs Gold. If you had to hold only one for the next 10 years, would you choose Bitcoin or gold? What makes your choice better than the other? Anons are split, but most zoomers are picking BTC while older posters are sticking with gold and calling bitcoin a bubble. The thread is full of conviction posts on both sides.
clips.source_hint: /biz/ thread asking BTC vs gold for a 10-year hold

signal.rationale: Most zoomers in thread pick BTC over gold for a 10-year hold; reflects long-term BTC bias

clips.text_en_b2: If you had to hold just one asset for the next decade, would you go with Bitcoin or gold? The thread is split straight down the middle, with younger anons backing BTC while older posters insist gold is the only sensible hedge and dismiss bitcoin as an unsustainable bubble. Despite that, I am picking BTC myself because gold is essentially a shiny toy at this point. Both camps are posting with absolute conviction, which makes the debate even harder to call.
clips.text_en_c1: The thread poses what has become a perennial question on /biz/: if you could hold a single asset for the next decade, would it be Bitcoin or gold, and on what basis do you judge one superior to the other? Responses are predictably polarised, with younger anons overwhelmingly backing BTC, whereas older posters dismiss it as a speculative bubble and reaffirm their conviction in gold as a store of value. Both camps trade conviction posts and counter-arguments with equal fervour, and the thread has since accrued several hundred replies dissecting the merits of each position.
clips.text_en_c2: A familiar thought experiment has resurfaced on /biz/: should one, given a single permissible holding and a ten-year horizon, commit capital to Bitcoin or to gold? The thread has bifurcated along generational fault lines, with zoomer posters extolling BTC's asymmetric upside and dismissing bullion as a vestigial relic, while their older interlocutors cling steadfastly to the yellow metal and decry the cryptocurrency as a textbook speculative bubble. Both camps post with the strident conviction peculiar to anonymous forums, marshalling macro charts and historical analogues alike. The result is a trenchant juxtaposition of worldviews, each articulated with sufficient eloquence that the uncommitted reader departs no closer to a verdict.

clips.text_zh: 特朗普講關稅收咗 21 trillion 美元。21T 喎，美國 GDP 都唔係咁多。呢個人真係當全部人係傻嘅。又係提款機新聞 🇺🇸📉
clips.text_en_b1: We took in 21 trillion dollars from tariffs? That is the number floating around on X today. To put that in context, total US federal revenue last year was about 5 trillion, so the claim is obviously nonsense. Anons are asking why the post is still up and who is farming engagement with it.
clips.source_hint: /biz/ thread about a viral claim of $21T tariff revenue

signal.rationale: Post-hoc reaction to a viral fake stat, no trade setup

clips.text_en_b2: Some post on X is claiming that tariffs brought in a staggering 21 trillion dollars, which is clearly absurd when you put it into context. Total US federal revenue last year barely scraped 5 trillion, so the figure does not hold up under even the most basic scrutiny. Anons are baffled that the post is still up and suspect someone is farming engagement rather than spreading genuine information. Nobody is buying it.
clips.text_en_c1: A claim currently circulating on X asserts that the administration has taken in some 21 trillion dollars from tariffs, a figure that, taken at face value, beggars belief. For context, total US federal revenue for the previous fiscal year amounted to roughly 5 trillion, so the claim is mathematically indefensible and can only be the product of deliberate misinformation. Anons are now asking, with a mixture of incredulity and resignation, why such a post remains live and which accounts stand to benefit from farming engagement around it.
clips.text_en_c2: A claim currently circulating on X asserts that the administration's tariff regime has garnered some twenty-one trillion dollars in revenue, a figure so patently absurd that it scarcely merits serious rebuttal. For context, total US federal receipts last fiscal year hovered around five trillion, meaning the supposed haul would exceed the entire tax take several times over. Anons on /biz/ are less exercised by the inaccuracy itself than by the post's continued visibility, which suggests either algorithmic amplification by grifters chasing engagement or a credulity so pervasive that correction has become futile. The consensus is a weary shrug.

clips.text_zh: /g/ 講緊 AI 泡沫爆咗之後，啲 GPU 唔會平。因為全部畀人熔咗再做嘢。咁我 NVDA short 應該遲啲先開，唔急住。FE 溫到 GPU architecture chapter，勁諗唔通。
clips.text_en_b1: You thought you could get cheap GPUs after the AI bubble pops? Think again, they are all getting melted down. Anons point out that once hyperscalers write off the H100 and B200 fleets, the silicon gets pulled for recovery and never hits the second-hand market at low prices.
clips.source_hint: /g/ thread claiming post-bubble GPUs will be scrapped, not discounted

signal.rationale: Macro observation about post-bubble GPU supply, not a trade setup

clips.text_en_b2: You assumed you could pick up cheap GPUs once the AI bubble eventually bursts, but that is unlikely to happen. Once hyperscalers write off their H100 and B200 fleets, the silicon gets pulled for recovery and melted down rather than dumped on the second-hand market. Anons point out that this means bargain hunters are out of luck, so any NVDA short position is probably better off opened later rather than in a rush.
clips.text_en_c1: The assumption that the collapse of the AI bubble will precipitate a glut of cheap second-hand GPUs is, according to /g/, fundamentally misguided. Once hyperscalers write off their H100 and B200 fleets, the silicon is unlikely to reach the resale market at depressed prices; instead, the chips will be pulled, melted down, and recycled for their raw materials. Anons advising on NVDA short positions therefore suggest holding fire rather than rushing in, given that supply may never meaningfully loosen even amid a downturn in demand.
clips.text_en_c2: A contrarian thesis propagated across /g/ posits that the imminent collapse of the AI bubble will not yield the GPU fire sale that bargain hunters anticipate, since hyperscaler fleets of H100 and B200 silicon are destined for the foundry crucible rather than the secondary market. Once depreciated and written off, the boards will be pulled for precious-metal recovery, rendering cheap accelerators a fantasy for prospective NVDA shorts. Whether this constitutes a structural floor under the company's valuations or merely an artefact of post-bubble logistics remains contested, though the thread's prevailing wisdom counsels patience, if not outright optimism.

clips.text_zh: /fit/ 有巴打吹茅屋芝士：高蛋白、cutting/bulking 都啱食、可以省一兩個菜、順便養腸道菌。Tommy 今次 slope investigation report 終於 pass，sum ho 冇再 comment，可以食返多盒芝士當慶祝。
clips.text_en_b1: Cottage cheese solves a lot of your protein. It is a great staple in a cutting or bulking diet, lets you skip some dishes, and supports your gut microbiome as a bonus. Anons are debating whether full-fat or low-fat is the better pick and posting their daily macros.
clips.source_hint: /fit/ thread praising cottage cheese as a protein staple
clips.text_en_b2: Cottage cheese quietly solves a huge chunk of your protein needs without much fuss. It slots into either a cutting or bulking diet, lets you skip a couple of extra dishes, and supports your gut microbiome as a bonus. Anons are currently debating whether full-fat or low-fat makes the smarter pick, while posting their daily macros to settle the matter once and for all.
clips.text_en_c1: Cottage cheese, long the butt of dietary jokes, is being rehabilitated on /fit/ as something of a miracle food for those pursuing a high-protein regimen. It slots seamlessly into both cutting and bulking phases, can plausibly substitute for one or two separate dishes, and, courtesy of its live cultures, confers tangible benefits upon the gut microbiome. Anons are presently split on whether full-fat or low-fat represents the superior choice, and the thread has devolved into the customary parade of daily macro breakdowns and unsolicited opinions.
clips.text_en_c2: A paean to cottage cheese has dominated /fit/ in recent days, extolling the curd as a versatile macronutrient-dense staple suitable for both cutting and bulking phases, capable of displacing entire side dishes at minimal caloric cost, and, as a serendipitous bonus, conferring demonstrable benefits upon the gut microbiome through its fermentable substrates. Anons have duly devolved into protracted skirmishes over the relative merits of full-fat versus low-fat variants, citing satiety profiles and macronutrient ratios alike. The thread has, predictably, become an impromptu confessional of daily protein intakes, each poster outdoing the last.

clips.text_zh: 巴打 deadlift 220kg 兩下，PR 240kg，仲話想試 245-250kg。我就 140kg 1 rep 都未試過，叫我點同肥仔信練 😭 考牌都未完，gym 都唔夠時間去。
clips.text_en_b1: I went deadlifting again, I did 220 kg for a double. I thought I could do more reps, I think I am just good at single reps and not good at higher reps. My PR is 240 kg and I have gotten stronger since, so I should have tried 245 or 250 kg. First time deadlifting in over a month.
clips.source_hint: /fit/ OP sharing a 220kg x2 deadlift session and a 240kg PR
clips.text_en_b2: I finally got back under the bar after a long break and pulled 220 kilograms for a double on my deadlift. Honestly, I think I could have pushed further because I tend to be stronger on singles rather than higher rep sets. My current PR sits at 240 kilograms, and since I have clearly gotten stronger, I should have at least attempted 245 or 250 while I had the chance.
clips.text_en_c1: Returned to deadlifting after a hiatus exceeding a month and managed a clean double at 220 kg, though I had anticipated clearing at least a third repetition with reasonable confidence. The discrepancy is not entirely surprising, given that I appear to be considerably stronger on singles than on higher-rep sets, a pattern that has held throughout my training. My standing PR of 240 kg was set some months ago, and since then I have continued to progress, so on reflection I ought to have opened at 245 or even 250 kg to test my ceiling.
clips.text_en_c2: Anon returns to the platform after an extended hiatus to report a respectable double at 220 kilograms, a weight he suspects underestimates his true capacity given that his standing PR of 240 has likely been surpassed during the intervening weeks. The customary second-guessing ensues: should he have loaded the bar to 245, perhaps even 250, and tested the outer limits of his deadlift? He concedes, with characteristic self-deprecation, that his physiology appears optimised for maximal singles rather than the grinding endurance demanded by higher repetitions. A minor lamentation follows, noting that examinations have left scant bandwidth for the iron.

clips.text_zh: Gochiusa 有新消息！S4 同劇場版都製作中，仲有 McDonald's 合作。歐氣爆棚。睇完好返去溫 FE，geotechnical chapter 真係想死。
clips.text_en_b1: Gochiusa. It is another beautiful day knowing Koi is working hard on season 4, the movie, and the next McDonald's collab. Anons are spamming cocoa fan art and counting the days until a proper trailer drops this winter.
clips.source_hint: /a/ thread with positive Gochiusa (S4, movie, McDonald's collab) news
clips.text_en_b2: There is finally some genuine news on the Gochiusa front, and it is shaping up to be a massive season. Season 4 and the upcoming movie are both in production, alongside a fresh McDonald's collaboration that nobody saw coming. Anons are celebrating hard, spamming cocoa fan art across the thread, and counting down the days until a proper trailer drops this winter.
clips.text_en_c1: News has broken that Koi is pressing ahead with production on both season 4 and an accompanying feature film, alongside a further collaboration with McDonald's, and anons on /a/ are savouring what can only be described as a windfall of good fortune. The thread has predictably descended into a torrent of cocoa fan art and countdown speculation, with posters eagerly anticipating a proper trailer by winter. For my part, I shall return to my geotechnical chapter and contemplate my dwindling enthusiasm for the FE examination.
clips.text_en_c2: News emanating from the Koi camp has occasioned unbridled jubilation upon /a/, with confirmation that season four, a forthcoming feature film, and yet another McDonald's collaboration are all presently in various stages of production. Anons have responded with the customary cascade of Cocoa fan art, interspersed with speculative countdown timers anticipating the winter trailer drop. Beneath the celebratory veneer, however, lurks the perpetual student anxiety: FE examinations loom, geotechnical chapters remain unconquered, and the syllabus shows no mercy. Such is the eternal tension between otaku indulgence and professional obligation.

clips.text_zh: 個 post 講：30 歲先變百萬富翁，zoomer 女仔全部畀人洗腦唔要 age gap，結果剩係搵到殘樣老女人。睇完好認命，我連百萬都未係，仲諗女人？我諗 prop firm 同 CFD 算。
clips.text_en_b1: Rich but over 30. Finally made it, but zoomer girls got psyopped into hating all age gap relationships. Became a millionaire only to be stuck with blown out roastie hags. Entire youth wasted scrimping and saving so that my real life can finally begin, only for society to rugpull zoomer girls. Anon says he cannot cope, it was all for nothing.
clips.source_hint: /biz/ anon lamenting being a rich 30+ with no dating options

signal.rationale: Pure life-pain vent, no trade setup

clips.text_en_b2: He finally made his first million at 30, only to find that zoomer girls have been psyopped into rejecting every age gap relationship on principle. Now he is stuck dating washed-up women while his entire youth was spent scrimping and saving for a future that turned out hollow. Anon says he cannot cope with the irony, claiming the whole grind was pointless in the end.
clips.text_en_c1: A recent post outlines what is, by now, a familiar lament: having only attained millionaire status at thirty, the author now finds himself in the unenviable position of being too old for younger women, who have, in his view, been psychologically manipulated into rejecting any prospect of an age-gap relationship. The consolation prize, as he sees it, is a dating pool consisting exclusively of women he characterises, with characteristic restraint, as past their prime. Having spent his youth scrimping and saving for a life that has since failed to materialise, he concludes, with no small measure of bitterness, that the entire exercise was for nothing.
clips.text_en_c2: A /biz/ confessional has articulated what its author frames as a generational tragedy: after decades of parsimonious accumulation, he belatedly crossed the millionaire threshold only to discover that zoomer women, having been thoroughly inculcated against age-gap entanglements, had rendered his hard-won prosperity largely ornamental. The remaining romantic prospects, he laments with characteristic acrimony, consist exclusively of women whose aesthetic prime has long since receded, leaving him to conclude that the antecedent sacrifices were retrospectively futile. The post terminates in the now-customary fatalism, though the reader suspects that financial anxieties, rather than romantic ones, constitute the true wellspring of the discontent.
